blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: `ledger import --quiet` SHALL print no progress line on standard error; errors SHALL still be printed, and the exit code SHALL be unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Add a scenario for `ledger import data.csv` on 2 500 rows that prints exactly two progress lines and exits 0, so an implementation that silences progress unconditionally fails a test; cover it in task 1.1.
findings.title: The spec never states that progress still prints without `--quiet`

findings.evidence: `src/main.rs` accepts `--quiet` before the file and passes it to
findings.location: design.md#Decision: The progress reporter takes a `quiet` switch
findings.recommendation: State in the spec whether `ledger import data.csv --quiet` is accepted or rejected (today `src/main.rs:6-9` matches only `[command, path]` and falls to the usage message `ledger import <file>` with exit code 2), add a scenario for it, and include the usage message in task 1.1 so it names `--quiet`.
findings.title: Where `--quiet` goes on the command line is decided only in the design, and the usage line is not updated
